title: APPLICABILITY OF THIS CHAPTER

blocks.html: The regulations of this Chapter shall apply:
blocks.plainText: The regulations of this Chapter shall apply:

blocks.html: (a)        To sky exposure plane buildings developed in R9 and R10 Districts, as set forth in Section 26-10 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR DEVELOPMENTS IN R9 AND R10 DISTRICTS). However, the provisions of Section 26-10 shall not apply within any Special Purpose District;
blocks.plainText: (a) To sky exposure plane buildings developed in R9 and R10 Districts, as set forth in Section 26-10 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR DEVELOPMENTS IN R9 AND R10 DISTRICTS). However, the provisions of Section 26-10 shall not apply within any Special Purpose District;

blocks.html: (b)        in R3, R4 and R5 Districts, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-20 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS), except where such zoning lots:
blocks.plainText: (b) in R3, R4 and R5 Districts, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-20 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS), except where such zoning lots:

blocks.html: (1)        consist entirely of single-family detached residences;
blocks.plainText: (1) consist entirely of single-family detached residences;

blocks.html: (2)        are accessed by private roads that existed on February 6, 2002; or
blocks.plainText: (2) are accessed by private roads that existed on February 6, 2002; or

blocks.html: (3)        are located within lower density growth management areas, in which case the provisions of paragraph (c) of this Section shall apply;
blocks.plainText: (3) are located within lower density growth management areas, in which case the provisions of paragraph (c) of this Section shall apply;

blocks.html: (c)        in lower density growth management areas, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-30 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS IN LOWER DENSITY GROWTH MANAGEMENT AREAS);
blocks.plainText: (c) in lower density growth management areas, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-30 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS IN LOWER DENSITY GROWTH MANAGEMENT AREAS);

blocks.html: (d)        to developments, enlargements or conversions in all districts, as applicable, as set forth in Section 26-40 (STREET TREE PLANTING AND PLANTING STRIP REQUIREMENTS); and
blocks.plainText: (d) to developments, enlargements or conversions in all districts, as applicable, as set forth in Section 26-40 (STREET TREE PLANTING AND PLANTING STRIP REQUIREMENTS); and

blocks.html: (e)        to all energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment not located within a completely enclosed building, as set forth in Section 26-60 (SPECIAL SCREENING AND ENCLOSURE PROVISIONS).
blocks.plainText: (e) to all energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment not located within a completely enclosed building, as set forth in Section 26-60 (SPECIAL SCREENING AND ENCLOSURE PROVISIONS).

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) To sky exposure plane buildings developed in R9 and R10 Districts, as set forth in Section 26-10 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR DEVELOPMENTS IN R9 AND R10 DISTRICTS). However, the provisions of Section 26-10 shall not apply within any Special Purpose District;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) in R3, R4 and R5 Districts, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-20 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS), except where such zoning lots:
(1) consist entirely of single-family detached residences;
(2) are accessed by private roads that existed on February 6, 2002; or
(3) are located within lower density growth management areas, in which case the provisions of paragraph (c) of this Section shall apply;

subsections.label: (c)
subsections.plainText: (c) in lower density growth management areas, to zoning lots with buildings accessed by private roads, as set forth in Section 26-30 (SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS IN LOWER DENSITY GROWTH MANAGEMENT AREAS);

subsections.label: (d)
subsections.plainText: (d) to developments, enlargements or conversions in all districts, as applicable, as set forth in Section 26-40 (STREET TREE PLANTING AND PLANTING STRIP REQUIREMENTS); and

subsections.label: (e)
subsections.plainText: (e) to all energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment not located within a completely enclosed building, as set forth in Section 26-60 (SPECIAL SCREENING AND ENCLOSURE PROVISIONS).
